title: Dereference `sizeof` operands outside an ordinary call statement, member operands and two reader quirks keep their refusal
why: Card W44-COLLECTION-ALLOCATION admits `*NAME`, `**NAME` and `NAME[LITERAL]` operands (every declaration of NAME a pointer declarator with enough stars, no array dimension, a specifier never variably modified) only at the lexical access gate of a statement whose first call is an ordinary callee. It withdrew 204 of the census's 226 `indirect memory access` leaves whose line's only access is such an operand (224 on 211 Unknown functions at BEFORE). Still refused: (a) a statement with no ordinary call (`n = sizeof(*p);`, 4 at the census) and conditions and returns naming such an operand, which the fixed scalar type-query rule (type_query.rs) does not read; (b) member operands `sizeof(*p->q)` / `sizeof(p->q)` (100 and 122 occurrences; 21 owned-result allocations); (c) the declarator reader reads `( NAME * sizeof …` as a declaration candidate and refuses the whole function's declarations, so `x_alloc(n * sizeof(*p))` keeps its refusal (test `a_leading_multiplication_the_declaration_reader_refuses_keeps_the_refusal`); (d) protected-formal discovery reads `sizeof(*p) * n` as a dereference of a formal `n`, so the argument refuses as `call has an unmodeled formal address or borrowed expression`; (e) 5 of the 14 `T **` allocation candidates keep a refusal for another access on their line. On the tree merged with main 70ce6b44, 234 `unsupported` leaves (232 on 119 Unknown functions) remain within two lines of a census dereference operand, 134 of them `indirect memory access` (an upper bound; most carry another access; docs/reports/w44-collection-allocation/census/residual-operands.txt). DISCHARGE: the type-query route widened to the same operand premise, member operands under the typed member reader, and the two reader quirks repaired, each with Lean parity and a measured re-pin.

title: The `C operator sizeof` family is a cast around a scalar query: 465 leaves, 398 of them `(T)(sizeof(NAME))`
why: The brief of card W44-COLLECTION-ALLOCATION pointed at the family `C operator \`sizeof\` requires type/operand analysis` (447 leaves on Unknown functions at the W43-INDEXED-RESOURCE-COLLECTIONS integration baseline). Its census (docs/reports/w44-collection-allocation/census/sizeof-census.txt) found it is not a dereference-operand family: 410 of the 447 sit on lines whose operand is a parenthesised name, and on the tree merged with main 70ce6b44 398 of the 465 leaves (all on Unknown functions; 122 Unknown functions carry the family) are librdkafka's `size_t __len2 = (size_t)(sizeof(_v));` macro expansion — a scalar query under a cast, which the fixed type-query rule (type_query.rs) replaces by its marker but `is_scalar_initializer` refuses for the cast. Only 1 Unknown function was blocked by this family alone at BEFORE (LZ4HC_rotatePattern). The card leaves it unchanged. DISCHARGE: a card admitting one leading scalar cast around an admitted type query in the scalar-initializer route (constraint 5a: the marker still never a value), with Lean parity and a measured re-pin.

title: 9 of the 14 `T **` array allocations are no longer refused (7 bind), and still no element operation decides under the collection rules
why: Card W44-COLLECTION-ALLOCATION's census found 14 self-referential dereference allocations into a `T **` destination; its admission withdrew the allocation refusal of 9, and 7 of those bind their destination (rd_kafka_conf_kv_split and rd_kafka_handle_ApiVersion reach another refusal; docs/reports/w44-collection-allocation/census/collection-reach.txt). Only one of those functions, rd_kafka_ListGroups_resp_cb, has an element operation the classifier lowers (`grps[i++] = rd_strndup(...)`, L24950), and its array does not resolve: `rd_malloc`'s result is nullable and the body never tests it, so `resolved_aggregate_owner` finds no non-null identity and the node is its fallback. The others fill their arrays through statements the element lowering does not take (call-argument accesses, named-pointer stores, member bounds). Re-measured on the tree merged with main 70ce6b44 (census run of the merged tree): unchanged. So 0 arrays became collections, 0 of the 27 recognised element operations moved, and 0 functions are Safe through collection element nodes. DISCHARGE: the first arbiter in which an admitted `T **` allocation's element operation resolves, measured alongside W43-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS, W43-COLLECTION-NAME-STORE and W43-COLLECTION-LOOP-SHAPES.
